verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a mobile git client that supports viewing diffs, commit graphs, branches, and pushing/pulling from GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket, which enables reviewing code changes on a phone, but there is no documented PR-specific review UI (inline PR comments, approve/request-changes, PR list view) — the evidence only covers generic git diff/commit browsing rather than a native pull-request review workflow. missing for 10: dedicated PR/MR list and detail view, ability to leave inline review comments or approve/request changes on a PR, independent hands-on confirmation of PR review workflow.
